$comment: Single source of truth for scheduled (cron) jobs. Every route here is POST-only, authenticated by the shared cron secret, and answers its work: a route whose capability is NOT_IMPLEMENTED (HTTP 501, guard class RETIRED in the route-coverage manifest) is not scheduled, because a schedule for it can only record a failed run every period; its intended cadence is kept in its capability entry (lib/reality/capability-registry.ts, UE-CRON-*) and the entry returns here when the route does real work. infrastructure/bicep/ue-v2/modules/apps.bicep generates one Azure Container Apps schedule job per entry from this file, and lib/operations/scheduled-jobs.contract.test.ts fails if a live cron route is missing here, if an entry names a route that does not exist, is not POST-only or is retired, or if the bicep stops reading this file. Schedules are UTC cron expressions chosen from each route's own documented cadence; the platform owner may tune them without touching a route. code is the Container Apps job name suffix (job names are limited to 32 characters).
